id.title: Privasi dan perlindungan data | oneQay
id.description: Privasi dan perlindungan data

blocks.title: Privasi dan perlindungan data
blocks.body: Versi 20 Oktober 2026. Silakan baca sebelum mendaftar dan menggunakan oneQay. Hubungi dukungan apabila ada bagian yang perlu dijelaskan.

blocks.title: Data bisnis Anda, akses sesuai kewenangan
blocks.body:
Data setiap bisnis dipisahkan berdasarkan akun bisnis. Dalam penggunaan normal, data operasional hanya tersedia bagi pemilik bisnis dan anggota tim yang diberi izin. Akun bisnis lain tidak diberi akses ke data Anda. Dashboard penyelenggara berfokus pada kesehatan layanan dan pengelolaan akun.

Personel penyelenggara atau penyedia infrastruktur yang berwenang mungkin perlu memproses data secara terbatas untuk menyediakan layanan, menangani permintaan dukungan, menyelidiki insiden, atau memenuhi kewajiban hukum. Akses tersebut harus dibatasi sesuai kebutuhan; kami tidak menjanjikan bahwa operator teknis sama sekali tidak dapat memproses data.

blocks.title: Data yang digunakan dan tujuannya
blocks.body: Data dapat meliputi identitas bisnis dan kontak, akun pegawai, produk, transaksi, catatan operasional, log keamanan, serta status pengiriman email. Data digunakan untuk menjalankan layanan, mengautentikasi akun, menyinkronkan transaksi, menyiapkan laporan dan menangani gangguan. Informasi marketing melalui email memerlukan pilihan terpisah dan dapat dihentikan melalui tautan preferensi.

blocks.title: Keamanan adalah kerja bersama
blocks.body:
Penyelenggara bertanggung jawab menjalankan kewajiban perlindungan data yang berlaku. Pemilik bisnis dan petugas turut menjaga keamanan akun, perangkat, hak akses, dan informasi login mereka. Aktifkan perlindungan akun yang tersedia, cabut akses pegawai yang tidak lagi bertugas, dan jangan mengirim kata sandi kepada pihak yang mengaku sebagai dukungan.

Saat offline, data sementara berada pada perangkat POS. Lindungi perangkat dan akses Windows, pantau sinkronisasi, dan amankan ekspor sebelum menghapus aplikasi atau mengganti perangkat.

blocks.title: Penyimpanan, pihak pendukung, dan insiden
blocks.body:
Penyimpanan data mengikuti tujuan layanan dan kewajiban retensi yang berlaku. Hosting dan penyedia email dapat memproses data yang diperlukan untuk menjalankan layanan; pengiriman email menggunakan alamat penerima dan isi pesan terkait. Data tidak digunakan sebagai alasan untuk memberi bisnis lain akses ke catatan Anda.

Jika terjadi insiden perlindungan data, penyelenggara menilai dampak, melakukan penanganan, serta memberikan pemberitahuan dan pemenuhan hak sesuai ketentuan hukum. Tidak ada janji keamanan mutlak, dan kebijakan ini bukan pembebasan penyelenggara dari kewajiban hukum.

blocks.title: Pertanyaan, koreksi dan permintaan data
blocks.body: Anda dapat menghubungi dukungan melalui halaman Kontak untuk menanyakan pemrosesan data, meminta akses atau koreksi, serta mengajukan penghentian atau penghapusan sesuai hak yang berlaku. Identitas dan kewenangan pemohon perlu diverifikasi. Permintaan tertentu dapat dibatasi karena catatan transaksi, pencegahan penyalahgunaan, atau kewajiban hukum; alasannya akan dijelaskan sejauh diizinkan.

en.title: Privacy and data protection | oneQay
en.description: Privacy and data protection

blocks.title: Privacy and data protection
blocks.body: Version 20 October 2026. Please read before registering and using oneQay. Contact support if you need clarification.

blocks.title: Your business data, authorized access
blocks.body:
Each business is isolated by its business account. In normal use, operating data is available only to the business owner and authorized team members. Other businesses are not granted access. The provider dashboard focuses on service health and account administration.

Authorized provider or infrastructure personnel may need limited processing to deliver the service, support you, investigate incidents or comply with law. Access must be limited to the need; we do not claim technical operators can never process data.

blocks.title: Data and purposes
blocks.body: Data may include business identity and contacts, staff accounts, products, transactions, operating records, security logs and email delivery status. It supports service operation, authentication, synchronization, reporting and incident handling. Marketing email requires a separate choice and can be stopped through preference links.

blocks.title: Security is a shared effort
blocks.body:
The provider remains responsible for applicable data-protection obligations. Business owners and staff also protect their accounts, devices, permissions and login information. Enable available account safeguards, revoke former staff access and never send passwords to someone claiming to be support.

Offline data temporarily resides on the POS device. Protect Windows and device access, monitor sync and secure exports before removing the application or replacing the device.

blocks.title: Storage, service providers and incidents
blocks.body:
Retention follows service purposes and applicable obligations. Hosting and mail providers may process data necessary to provide the service, including recipient addresses and relevant message content. This does not give other businesses access to your records.

For a data-protection incident, the provider assesses impact, responds and fulfills applicable notification and data-subject obligations. There is no absolute-security promise or waiver of statutory provider duties.

blocks.title: Questions and data requests
blocks.body: Contact official support through Contact for processing questions, access, correction, restriction or deletion requests under applicable rights. Identity and authority must be verified. Transaction records, abuse prevention or legal retention may limit some requests; reasons will be explained where permitted.

id.title: Ketentuan penggunaan | oneQay
id.description: Ketentuan penggunaan

blocks.title: Ketentuan penggunaan
blocks.body: Versi 20 Oktober 2026. Silakan baca sebelum mendaftar dan menggunakan oneQay. Hubungi dukungan apabila ada bagian yang perlu dijelaskan.

blocks.title: Layanan untuk operasional bisnis
blocks.body: oneQay membantu pencatatan penjualan, persediaan, tim, dan laporan bisnis yang sah. Dengan mendaftar, Anda menyatakan berwenang mewakili bisnis dan memberikan informasi yang benar. Email harus dikuasai pemilik bisnis dan diverifikasi sebelum akun aktif. Penggunaan aplikasi saat ini gratis sesuai halaman Harga.

blocks.title: Akun dan akses tim
blocks.body: Pemilik bisnis mengatur akses pegawai sesuai tugasnya, meninjau transaksi, dan memastikan penggunaan data pelanggan memiliki dasar yang sah. Gunakan kata sandi yang kuat, authenticator bila tersedia, dan akun berbeda untuk setiap petugas. Jangan membagikan tautan aktivasi, PIN, kode pemulihan atau kata sandi.

blocks.title: Penggunaan yang diperbolehkan
blocks.body: Gunakan layanan untuk bisnis Anda sesuai hukum. Dilarang memakai layanan untuk kegiatan ilegal, penipuan, penyalahgunaan data, serangan sistem, akses tanpa izin, atau tindakan yang mengganggu pengguna lain. Menjual ulang, menyewakan akses, mengatasnamakan, atau mendistribusikan layanan oneQay tanpa izin tertulis penyelenggara tidak diperbolehkan.

blocks.title: Hak cipta dan izin penggunaan
blocks.body: Hak atas source code, antarmuka, merek, dan materi asli oneQay tetap pada pemegang hak yang sah serta dilindungi ketentuan hak cipta yang berlaku. Izin memakai layanan gratis bukan pengalihan hak atas source code. Tanpa izin tertulis, pengguna tidak diperkenankan menyalin, memodifikasi, menjiplak, mendistribusikan atau memperjualbelikan bagian yang dilindungi, dengan tetap menghormati pengecualian menurut hukum dan lisensi komponen pihak ketiga. Data bisnis tetap menjadi hak bisnis atau pihak yang berhak atas data tersebut.

blocks.title: Penangguhan dan pengakhiran akses
blocks.body:
Penyelenggara dapat membatasi, menangguhkan, atau mengakhiri akun yang melanggar ketentuan, menggunakan layanan di luar peruntukan, melanggar hukum, atau menimbulkan ancaman keamanan. Alasan penangguhan dikirim ke email pemilik bisnis, kecuali dilarang hukum. Penangguhan tidak otomatis menghapus transaksi. Hubungi dukungan melalui halaman Kontak untuk klarifikasi atau keberatan.

Penghapusan permanen memerlukan peninjauan terpisah dengan mempertimbangkan kewajiban retensi, hak subjek data, serta kesempatan ekspor yang wajar apabila diperbolehkan dan memungkinkan. Tindakan darurat dapat dilakukan lebih dahulu untuk melindungi layanan.

blocks.title: Menjaga catatan dan kelangsungan usaha
blocks.body:
Penyelenggara mengupayakan layanan dan perlindungan data yang wajar, namun tidak ada sistem yang sepenuhnya bebas gangguan atau risiko. Pemilik bisnis sebaiknya memeriksa hasil pencatatan, menyimpan ekspor berkala, dan memastikan antrean offline telah tersinkron sebelum menghapus atau mengganti perangkat.

Penanganan kehilangan data, insiden keamanan, dan tanggung jawab masing-masing pihak mengikuti fakta kejadian serta hukum yang berlaku. Ketentuan ini tidak menghapus kewajiban hukum penyelenggara atau hak pengguna yang tidak dapat dikesampingkan. Untuk sengketa, para pihak diharapkan terlebih dahulu mencari penyelesaian secara musyawarah melalui saluran dukungan resmi.

en.title: Terms of use | oneQay
en.description: Terms of use

blocks.title: Terms of use
blocks.body: Version 20 October 2026. Please read before registering and using oneQay. Contact support if you need clarification.

blocks.title: A service for legitimate business operations
blocks.body: oneQay supports sales, stock, staff and business records. By registering, you confirm that you may represent the business and provide accurate information. Verify an email controlled by the business owner before activation. Application use is currently free as described on Pricing.

blocks.title: Accounts and team access
blocks.body: Business owners assign staff permissions, review transactions and ensure lawful use of customer data. Use strong passwords, available authenticators and individual staff accounts. Never share activation links, PINs, recovery codes or passwords.

blocks.title: Acceptable use
blocks.body: Use the service for lawful business. Illegal activity, fraud, data misuse, attacks, unauthorized access and disruption of other users are prohibited. Reselling, renting access, impersonating or distributing oneQay without the provider’s written permission is not permitted.

blocks.title: Copyright and permission to use
blocks.body: Rights in original oneQay source code, interface, brand and materials remain with their lawful holders under applicable copyright law. Free service access does not transfer source-code rights. Copying, modifying, imitating, distributing or selling protected material requires written permission, subject to statutory exceptions and third-party component licenses. Business data remains with the business or its lawful rights holders.

blocks.title: Suspension and termination
blocks.body:
The provider may restrict, suspend or terminate accounts for terms violations, misuse, unlawful activity or security threats. Suspension reasons are emailed to the business owner unless prohibited by law. Suspension does not automatically erase transactions. Contact official support through Contact for clarification or an appeal.

Permanent deletion requires separate review of retention obligations, data-subject rights and a reasonable export opportunity where permitted and feasible. Emergency restrictions may precede notice to protect the service.

blocks.title: Records and business continuity
blocks.body:
The provider takes reasonable steps to maintain service and protect data, but no system is entirely free of interruption or risk. Business owners should review records, keep periodic exports and verify offline sync before deleting or replacing devices.

Data-loss incidents, security events and responsibility are assessed using the facts and applicable law. These terms do not waive mandatory provider obligations or non-waivable user rights. Parties should first seek an amicable resolution through official support.

Cara kerja berbeda.
Ruang tumbuh yang sama.

Anda melangkah.

items.title: 01 · Daftarkan bisnis
items.body: Isi informasi bisnis dan email pemilik yang aktif.

items.title: 02 · Aktivasi akun
items.body: Buka tautan verifikasi dan buat kata sandi. Akun langsung aktif; Anda menjadi admin bisnis sendiri.

items.title: 03 · Siapkan operasional
items.body: Tambahkan produk, staf, dan hak akses, lalu mulai bertransaksi.

items.title: Siapa yang menjadi admin bisnis?
items.body: Pemilik yang mengaktifkan undangan menjadi admin untuk bisnisnya sendiri.

items.title: Bisakah produk diimpor sekaligus?
items.body: Ya. Gunakan template CSV atau Excel, lalu periksa pratinjau sebelum menyimpan.

items.title: Apakah laporan bisa diunduh?
items.body: Laporan mendukung PDF dan Excel sesuai hak akses pengguna.

items.title: Apakah pendaftaran langsung menagih biaya?
items.body: Saat ini gratis tanpa biaya langganan aplikasi. Tidak ada penagihan otomatis. Perangkat, internet dan layanan pihak ketiga menjadi biaya bisnis. Perubahan paket di masa depan akan diinformasikan lebih dahulu.

blocks.title: Tetap paham kondisi bisnis Anda.
blocks.body:
Pemilik bisnis mengatur produk, stok, pegawai, dan hak akses melalui web. Kasir masuk ke aplikasi POS Windows menggunakan akun masing-masing. Setiap shift dimulai dengan kas awal dan ditutup dengan pencatatan kas akhir serta pemeriksaan selisih.

Saat tersambung, transaksi yang berhasil disinkronkan memperbarui laporan server. Jika internet terputus, POS menyimpan antrean transaksi lokal sesuai masa akses offline. Data tersebut baru terlihat di web setelah sinkronisasi berhasil. Pantau indikator koneksi dan amankan perangkat kasir.

Siap menata langkah
bisnis berikutnya?
blocks.body: Mulai dari satu pendaftaran. Bangun ruang kerja yang lebih teratur bersama oneQay.

en.title: oneQay — Organized business. Confident growth.
en.description: Checkout, inventory, customers, teams and business reports in one oneQay workspace.

blocks.title:
One workspace.
More room to grow.
blocks.body:
Move from paper records to digital operations you can follow. oneQay brings sales, stock, employees and business reports into one workspace.

Currently free. Register with your email, verify it, and start setting up your business without manual approval.
blocks.eyebrow: FREE FOR BUSINESSES READY TO GROW

items.title: Point of sale
items.body: Open shifts, record sales, accept cash and issue receipts in a connected checkout flow.

items.title: Products & inventory
items.body: Manage SKUs, barcodes, variants and stock. Import Excel or CSV catalogs with a preview before saving.

items.title: Purchasing & suppliers
items.body: Track suppliers, purchase orders, approvals and goods receipts with a clear history.

items.title: Customer management
items.body: Keep customer, contact and interaction records consistent across your team.

items.title: People & teams
items.body: Manage staff, attendance, leave, roles and access according to business responsibilities.

items.title: Reports & monitoring
items.body: Follow sales trends and operating reports. Download PDF and Excel within your access scope.

items.title: Finance & bookkeeping
items.body: Manage finance records, journals, trial balances and shift cash closing with a traceable history.

items.title: Access & security
items.body: Separate owner, manager and cashier access. Protect privileged accounts with an authenticator and renewed verification.

blocks.title:
Clear stock.
Confident decisions.
blocks.body: Start with the products you sell. Import your catalog in bulk, review each row before saving, then follow your stock and its movements.

blocks.title:
Different businesses.
The same room to grow.
blocks.body: Choose your business type at registration. Laundry, boarding and homestay each have their own workspace and operational records. One Windows application adapts to the signed-in business.

items.title: Retail stores
items.body: Products, stock and checkout in one flow.

items.title: Food & beverage
items.body: Keep daily sales and stock needs in view.

items.title: Service businesses
items.body: Bring services, customers and your team together.

items.title: Laundry
items.body: Intake, per-kg or per-item rates, processing stages, invoices and collection.

items.title: Boarding houses
items.body: Rooms and residents, rental contracts, period invoices, payments and register shifts.

items.title: Homestays
items.body: Nightly reservations, room availability checks, check-in, invoices and check-out.

blocks.title:
Numbers that help
you move forward.
blocks.body: Review sales trends and operating reports. Download a PDF to share or an Excel file for further analysis.

items.title: 01 · Register
items.body: Enter your business details and an active owner email.

items.title: 02 · Activate
items.body: Open the verification link and set your password. Your account activates automatically as your business administrator.

items.title: 03 · Set up
items.body: Add products, staff and access rights, then start selling.

items.title: Who becomes the business admin?
items.body: The owner who activates the invitation becomes the admin of their own business.

items.title: Can I import products in bulk?
items.body: Yes. Use the CSV or Excel template and review the preview before saving.

items.title: Can I download reports?
items.body: Reports support PDF and Excel downloads within each user’s access.

items.title: Does registration charge me?
items.body: Currently free with no application subscription or automatic billing. Hardware, internet and third-party services are your business costs. Future plan changes will be announced in advance.

blocks.title: Stay in touch with your business.
blocks.body:
Business owners manage products, stock, employees and access on the web. Cashiers use their own accounts in Windows POS. Each shift starts with opening cash and ends with counted cash and variance review.

Successfully synced transactions update server reports while connected. During an outage, POS keeps a local queue within its offline access period. These transactions appear on the web only after successful sync. Watch the connection indicator and secure the register.

Ready for your
next business chapter?
blocks.body: Start with one registration. Build a more organized workspace with oneQay.
